rules: First paint never waits for IndexedDB: recovery projection, pending outbox, then legacy mirror provide synchronous ordered page_id state.
Before migration is activated, current local ordered page_ids are written to PrometeoDB and read back for exact ordered parity; only then is the migration marker activated.
After activation, PrometeoDB owns canonical truth. A no-outbox reload hydrates the synchronous mirrors from PrometeoDB.
Every UI mutation writes recovery mirror, rollback mirror and outbox synchronously before asynchronous PrometeoDB flush.
A pending outbox wins over stale PrometeoDB after crash/reload and is flushed before normal hydration.
If IndexedDB is unavailable, local interaction continues from recovery/outbox state; the intent remains queued for later flush.
If the activated canonical DB row is missing but recovery projection survives, repair PrometeoDB from recovery instead of silently erasing Favorites.
The legacy V5 key is not deleted by v2; it remains a verified rollback/compatibility projection.
No server/network is required for Favorites.
Catalog pruning continues to preserve relative order of valid stable page_ids.
Canonical ownership cutover does not imply Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
promotion_gates: rollback and recovery mirrors equal DB after settled writes
mobile and desktop browser canaries before Served publication
atomic payload manifest validation before gh-pages write
